item.title: Google Discloses PageBreak AI Security Agent That Found 500+ XSS Bugs
item.description: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January. (1 source: infoq)
